limits: Two real aircraft; fixed GLB pose and translation-only casts
Static local chunks; no streaming, geodetic conversion, rendering or JSBSim response
Awake hot-cache block throughput; p95 is a block average, not frame latency
Source meshes have open boundaries; first surface contact is the reference, not solid containment
No GPU execution or mobile-device inference
